name: ft3-pi-runtime
description: Pinned Pi harness bundled with FT3 as the built-in/default provider for local OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The npm dependency @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (exact pin) ships the CLI inside FT3's package graph; the bundled runtime is required.

protocol.streamText: message_update.text_delta only; message_end text only when nothing streamed

packaging.serverModuleResolution: resolvePiRuntime walks upward from apps/server/dist to server.asar/node_modules
packaging.runtimeHost: HostProcessExecutablePath with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 forwarded by the desktop backend

permissions.enforcement: explicit FT3-managed Pi tool_call extension; Pi launches with --no-extensions and only this extension path
permissions.workspacePaths: realpath-resolved before execution; external paths prompt; approval-required writes block
permissions.shell: one-time approval outside full-access because Pi has no OS sandbox
permissions.limitations: pre-execution extension is not an OS sandbox; shell approvals are stricter than auto commandExecution

remainingWork: Run a live end-to-end pass against a local endpoint (Ollama): prompt, steer, abort, extension-UI dialog, crash-restart
Consider RPC get_available_models for model listing instead of CLI --list-models parsing
